issues.where: crops S, T, U, and V along the lower globe, Andes, Pacific clouds, and Brazilian night lights (also visible in image-05.png and image-06.png crops D and E)
issues.what: severe texture stretching, radial smearing, and blurry upsampling turn clouds, mountain relief, and city lights into soft diagonal streaks that expose a low-resolution plate reprojected onto a sphere
issues.fix: render the close-up from high-resolution full-globe surface, night-light, and cloud maps instead of zooming and reprojecting a single 2D plate

issues.where: crop L along the upper-right aurora limb (also visible in image-06.png crop I and image-05.png upper right)
issues.what: a doubled edge and projection seam run along the limb where green aurora baked onto the globe surface cuts off at a sharp rim line beneath a second outer aurora layer
issues.fix: remove all baked sky and aurora glow from the planet surface texture and render the aurora strictly as a separate 3D atmospheric volume above the limb

issues.where: crops A, B, C, F, and G across Central America, the Caribbean, North America, and northern South America (also image-07.png crops J, K, O, P, and Q)
issues.what: land, coastlines, and clouds look soft, upsampled, and airbrushed at native crop scale, with flat painted relief and baked cloud shadows lacking crisp detail
issues.fix: increase planetary surface and cloud texel density (16K-32K or tiled textures) and separate cloud geometry from the terrain albedo

issues.where: crop M around the Moon and surrounding dark sky (from image-01.png upper right)
issues.what: the Moon has a jagged stair-stepped lit limb, a dark seam along its night limb, and a circular dark halo patch that suppresses the surrounding sky glow amidst 8x8 compression blocks in the dark background
issues.fix: supersample and anti-alias the Moon limb cleanly without an oversized dark matte halo, and use an uncompressed 16-bit starfield skybox to eliminate dark-gradient macroblocking

issues.where: crop H near Patagonia and the bottom limb (also image-04.png crop V)
issues.what: clouds, ocean, and the southern tip of South America pinch and swirl tangentially along the extreme lower limb
issues.fix: use undistorted spherical UV mapping and full-globe polar coverage so textures do not swirl or pinch near the southern limb

issues.where: crop J in the upper-left Milky Way starfield (also image-06.png crop H)
issues.what: stars near the corner smear into soft, elongated blobs compared with sharper stars nearer frame center
issues.fix: render stars as sharp analytic point sources or sample a higher-resolution skybox without corner projection blur

issues.where: lower half, south Pacific clouds and night-side South America
issues.what: directional smear: clouds, terrain, and city lights streak, while the day side over North America stays sharp
issues.fix: remove the directional blur so southern clouds, terrain, and city lights match the sharp day side

issues.where: crops T, U, and V: southern cloud field, Andes coast, and night coast
issues.what: native crops are streaked end to end; city lights are dashes rather than points, and the mountain texture is smeared
issues.fix: rebuild these crops from an unblurred frame so edges and lights stay crisp at native size

issues.where: crop E, eastern South America into the night side, and the lower right of crop H
issues.what: crop E is motion-smeared across terrain, coastline, and city lights; crop H softens toward the Amazon
issues.fix: replace these crops with a sharp night-side pass and keep city lights as small points

issues.where: crops P and Q, and the outer bands of the hurricane in crop O
issues.what: land, night clouds, and the storm's outer arms smear on one diagonal while the eye stays sharper
issues.fix: drop the smear on the South American crops and the outer storm bands so they match the sharper eye and northern day side
